oh_5_the_pit.blurb: A compact, enclosed corner of the old sandstone quarry at Logtown, near Lisbon in northeast Ohio, sitting toward the right-hand end of the main cliffs. Three walls and a blocky roof form a bowl-shaped alcove. All thirteen lines are traditional routes, and several can also be top-roped. Grades run from 5.4 to 5.10, with most falling between 5.6 and 5.10, so it works well for newer leaders learning to place gear on short, friendly climbs. The stone is better low down and gets weaker near the rim. Expect company on fair-weather weekends, since the whole quarry draws climbers from Ohio and Pennsylvania.
oh_5_the_pit.approach: A short walk from the car: go up the stone stairs to the paved trail, follow the fence line to its end, then take the stone steps up to the cliff. Bear right at the base and the alcove is on that side of the climbing.
